item.title: Funds to kickstart stalled housing project in Langley Mill
item.description: More than £1 million is to be spent kickstarting a stalled project to build more than 100 homes on a brownfield site in Langley Mill. item.description: Police would like to speak to this man after a diner left a restaurant without paying. item.title: EMR release final chapter of its Aurora documentary
item.description: East Midlands Railway (EMR) has released the final chapter of its documentary about the roll out of their new state of the art Aurora fleet. The final chapter of the Aurora documentary focuses on how EMR, which is operated by Transport UK, is training its staff to operate the new £400 million fleet. The episode […]

item.title: PCC proposes council tax rise of over 5% for policing in the county
item.description: Residents across Nottinghamshire could have their precept for policing go up by more than five percent from April. Nottinghamshire’s Police and Crime Commissioner, Gary Godden (Lab), is proposing a 5.1 percent increase on the precept for policing, which forms a part of residents’ council tax bills. item.title: Nottingham: Sex offender jailed after hundreds of indecent images found
item.description: A sex offender has been jailed after detectives found hundreds of indecent images of children on his mobile devices. Police were initially alerted that an indecent photograph had been downloaded at an address in the Alfreton Road area of Nottingham. item.description: An investigation is underway following a reported robbery at an East Bridgford home. item.title: Stun guns found in house raid during Nottingham city raid
item.description: Two taser guns were seized by City West officers during a warrant at a house. The neighbourhood policing team made the discoveries while visiting a property in Bodmin Drive, Aspley. item.description: Wednesday will start cold and murky across Nottinghamshire, with patches of mist and low cloud lingering through the early morning. Temperatures around dawn will sit close to 1–2°C, with a slight frost in places, particularly in sheltered spots.
